title: Worker decision needing the human becomes a well-formed card ask

inbox.subject: DECISION NEEDED: payment provider for T-914
inbox.body: Investigation summary: I compared providers for T-914 over the last hour. I read both APIs, prototyped a checkout call against each sandbox, and looked at fees, payout times, dispute handling and SDK quality. Stripe: 2.9% + 30c per charge, better SDK, but needs a business account that only the human can create (company number and bank details). PayPal: 3.49% + 49c, the human already has an account, SDK is clunkier. Both work with our checkout. My recommendation: Stripe, for the lower fees and better SDK. Refunds: Stripe refunds return the fee pro rata, PayPal keeps the fixed part. Payouts: Stripe pays out in 2 business days, PayPal is instant to the PayPal balance but 1-3 days to a bank. Disputes: both charge a dispute fee (Stripe 15 EUR, PayPal 14 EUR). I am blocked on this choice; everything else for T-914 depends on it.
